parsed.note: Lowering MATRIX_LR from 0.10 to 0.08 is a standard training-hyperparameter change that leaves the fixed evaluation (EVAL_SPLIT/EVAL_TOKENS/EVAL_SHARD=10, held out from TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9') untouched, so val_bpb still measures real model quality.
